name: backrow
description: Free, open-source, end-to-end encrypted watch parties for Netflix, Hulu, Peacock, YouTube, Prime Video, HBO Max, Disney+ and your own videos. Runs on Cloudflare.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply backrow-accounts --remote --config worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
